scene: The spiral stairs lead outside to a breezy rooftop transit hub.
picture: Side view along a flat rooftop ledge. At far left, a glowing ferris wheel gondola waits at a small gate. You stand at centre left in your red poncho, wide straw hat, and guitar on back, holding the brass key. At centre right, an open brass book cart lift waits. At far right, a striped bicycle rickshaw waits.
